# Repair Estimator — agent courtesy file (NOT a GEO strategy)

> Deterministic, provenance-tracked repair estimates from verified government data.
> Every figure carries exactly one badge: VERIFIED / USER_PROVIDED / MODELED /
> REQUIRES_KEY / UNAVAILABLE. Same inputs → same outputs. Estimates, never simulations.

Note for agent operators: this llms.txt is a crawler-courtesy file only. Per 2026
data (AnswerMetrix/Ahrefs), llms.txt receives negligible direct LLM traffic — do
not treat it as a visibility lever. The citable surfaces are the /e/{estimate_id}
markdown twins and JSON-LD Dataset pages.

## API
- POST /v1/estimate_repair {address, state, zip_code, findings[]}  (Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>)
- GET /s/{token} lender share portal
- GET /api/health data-host health + latency + VERIFIED% metrics
- GET /metrics Prometheus exposition

## Provenance badges
VERIFIED · USER_PROVIDED · MODELED · REQUIRES_KEY · UNAVAILABLE

## Rules
- MODELED figures are deterministic estimates, not quotes.
- USER_QUOTE rows are authoritative and always win.
- Every figure carries as_of + source_url + retrieved_at.
